PoseMatch.description: An output image's nearest reference pose.

close.description: A close pose match: distance below the comparison's threshold with at least params.min_close_joints shared joints (the whole limb skeleton by default). It means 'the same pose', not 'a copied frame': most same-stance poses match at the default threshold. Use it as a pointer to the training frame an image-level check should compare against; the run-level signal is close_excess.
close.title: Close

distance.description: Pose distance between the two; null exactly when nearest is null.
distance.title: Distance

nearest.description: The reference image with the closest pose; null when the output is unusable or shares too few joints with every reference pose (no comparable reference pose). When the output is close, the nearest reference that shares the whole limb skeleton with it (which may differ from the nearest partial match).
nearest.title: Nearest

shared_joints.description: Non-head body joints (of 12: shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles) confident in both poses in the orientation compared; null exactly when nearest is null.
shared_joints.title: Shared Joints

unusable_reason.description: Why the output is not usable, when it is not (then nearest is null): 'no_person' (no primary person), 'no_confident_torso' (neither a hip nor a shoulder at params.min_joint_score), 'no_confident_hip' (a shoulder but no hip, e.g. a waist-up crop), 'no_confident_shoulder' (a hip but no shoulder, e.g. a legs crop), 'scale_too_small' (torso under 4 px), 'too_few_joints' (fewer than params.min_usable_joints confident body joints); the first failing check, in that order (docs/metrics.md). Null for a usable output, matched or not (and in payloads before puppet_version 1.2).
unusable_reason.title: Unusable Reason

PoseSetComparison.description:
An output set's poses against a reference (training) set: close pose matches against the reference set's own
baseline, and coverage drift.

baseline_close_share.description: The same statistic inside the reference set, leave-one-out: the share of eligible reference poses whose nearest *other* reference pose (sharing params.min_close_joints joints) is closer than the threshold. How often training frames are close to each other, i.e. what close_share looks like without any copying. Null with fewer than 2 usable reference poses or none eligible.
baseline_close_share.title: Baseline Close Share

baseline_eligible.description: Reference poses that could be close to another reference pose (leave-one-out, same rules).
baseline_eligible.title: Baseline Eligible

close_eligible.description: Outputs that could be close: they share at least params.min_close_joints joints with at least one reference pose (in practice: the output and some reference frame both show the whole limb skeleton). close_share is over these.
close_eligible.title: Close Eligible

close_excess.description: max(0, close_share - baseline_close_share): how much more often outputs sit within the threshold of a training frame than training frames sit to each other. The run-level copying signal; null when baseline_close_share is null.
close_excess.title: Close Excess

close_share.description: Close outputs / close_eligible (0 when none is eligible). On its own it is not evidence of copying: compare it with baseline_close_share.
close_share.title: Close Share

coverage_divergence.description: Jensen-Shannon divergence (base 2) between the output and reference coverage histograms, averaged over stance, arms and facing: 0 = same mix of poses, 1 = disjoint.
coverage_divergence.title: Coverage Divergence

estimator.description: The estimator that produced every pose on both sides, when they all share one.

matched_count.description: Outputs with a nearest reference pose: usable, and comparable with at least one usable reference pose.
matched_count.title: Matched Count

matches.description: One per output image, sorted by image name; nearest/distance are null for an unmatched output.
matches.title: Matches

output_count.description: Output images compared, usable or not (one match entry each).
output_count.title: Output Count

output_nn_distance.description: Quantiles, over the eligible outputs, of the distance to the nearest reference pose sharing params.min_close_joints joints; null when no output is eligible.

output_unusable_reasons.description: How many output images are unusable for each reason (matches' unusable_reason), listing only reasons that occur; empty when every output is usable (and in payloads before puppet_version 1.2).
output_unusable_reasons.title: Output Unusable Reasons

reference_nn_distance.description: Quantiles, over the eligible reference poses, of the distance to the nearest other reference pose sharing params.min_close_joints joints (leave-one-out); null when baseline_close_share is null. Outputs whose quantiles sit well below these are closer to the training frames than the frames are to each other.

reference_unusable_reasons.description: How many reference images are unusable for each reason, listing only reasons that occur; empty when every reference image is usable (and in payloads before puppet_version 1.2).
reference_unusable_reasons.title: Reference Unusable Reasons

threshold.description: Pose distance below which a match can be close.
threshold.title: Threshold
